migrates_from._note: One-time MOVE into ~/.my-llm-wiki on first launch of the rebuilt app (desktop paths::migrate_legacy). No symlink, no fallback reads — a clean cutover, so any leftover reference to these fails loudly.

capture_toolchain._note: Fetchers the skills delegate to. `strongly_recommended` = near-mandatory for a smooth capture flow (AGENTS.md step 3): recommend loudly at install time with the home URL, but only install with the user's go-ahead. doctor.py reports these as core adapters. `install_cn` = mainland-China network variant — sometimes a different CHANNEL, not just a mirror flag (yt-dlp: the pip build self-updates through the PyPI mirror; brew/winget builds self-update against GitHub Releases and go stale). Probe first (cn-mirrors skill scripts/net_probe.py, or preflight.py's network line) and pick the matching variant.

strongly_recommended.name: opencli
strongly_recommended.without_it: 公众号 images stay remote; 小红书/抖音 captures fail (login-walled); X degrades

strongly_recommended.name: yt-dlp
strongly_recommended.without_it: no video→transcript path (captions and audio both come through it)

strongly_recommended.name: ffmpeg
strongly_recommended.install_cn: brew install ffmpeg (macOS — slow bottles: set TUNA HOMEBREW_BOTTLE_DOMAIN); Windows: winget's FFmpeg fetches from GitHub and fails — use https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ and put its bin on PATH
strongly_recommended.without_it: no audio extraction / covers for the video path

first_run._note: Browser port is resolved like the app itself (desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs): port_pref_file > $PORT > default_port. Health probe only needs liveness — an auth-gated response (token required) still proves the server is up.
